name: switch
description: A labelled on/off toggle for a setting that applies immediately, like turning notifications on. For a choice that waits for a form submit use a checkbox.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, shown next to the track and announced by screen readers.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Controlled on state; pair with onChange.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new on state.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents changes and dims the switch.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the switch submits value when on.

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted with the form when on.
